caption: The drawing features a single object, a lidded tankard with an ornate handle. The tankard is positioned in profile view, showing its cylindrical body, wide base, and domed lid with a decorative thumb piece on top. The handle is attached to the left side, arching outward and ending in a curled tip. The drawing is rendered in shades of black, gray, and white, with shading and lines used to suggest metallic shine and surface curvature. The background is filled with loose, mottled brownish-orange wash, and the whole scene is enclosed within a lightly sketched rectangular frame. In the lower right corner, handwritten text reads, "Silver Tankard, Slightly larger than actual size, approx 4" x 6", Jn. M. Austin." The lower left corner has the marking "Case #1."
title: Silver Tankard
